title: MY BUNNY ATE THE KING'S CHAINS.
summary: A child’s ten-year egg hatches a hungry bunny whose appetite for chains sets the king’s monsters free and stirs something under the castle.
frame_0: An iron-grey bunny towers over a child in the sunlit throne room. Its ears reach the roof, a chain hangs from its teeth, and the king’s loose crown rolls across the carpet.
camera: locked shots with slow moves on lines 15 and 19
